We report two metrics: • Rationale Accuracy (RA): The percentage of questions when the verifier selects the valid solution from the set of candidates. • Answer Accuracy (AA): The percentage of questions when the verifier selects a solution with a correct answer (regardless of whether the rationale is valid or not) from the set of candidates.
